golden_supported_hypothesis.purpose: Lawful supported_hypothesis record: disclosed customer/supplier leg + comparable + market context, mechanism hypothesized.

golden_typed_abstention_rights_blocked.purpose: Lawful typed abstention: RESOLVED identity, but the only Graph-1 leg is rights_blocked.

golden_typed_abstention_unresolved.purpose: Lawful typed abstention: NOT_IN_MASTER identity, zero evidence legs, zero mechanism.

hostile_admission_owner_not_generator_na.purpose: Admission's owner_ref names a construct-lawful owner that is not the admitting generator's own declared native_owner.

hostile_authority_trading_true.purpose: authority.trading flipped true against the const all-false object.

hostile_binding_kills_drop.purpose: One of the four const binding_kills entries dropped.

hostile_clock_violations.purpose: One leg with known_at after asof (lookahead), one leg with an unparseable clock.

hostile_disagreeing_derived_summary.purpose: Caller-authored graph_states/hypothesis_state/abstention disagree with the actual derivation.

hostile_economic_share_nonnull.purpose: economic_share tampered non-null; it is a reserved-null axis.

hostile_forbidden_key_injection.purpose: A scalar-authority-shaped key ('confidence_note') smuggled into source_event.

hostile_generator_refusal_admission.purpose: The registry's one admits_target=false refusal row used as a target-admitting generator.

hostile_mechanism_trade_language.purpose: Trade/price vocabulary ('rally', 'price target') smuggled into mechanism prose.

hostile_mechanism_without_relationship.purpose: Mechanism hypothesized while relationship_paths stays empty (no Graph-1 support).

hostile_relationship_construct_launderin.purpose: Graph-2/Graph-3 constructs (theme_membership, residual_comovement) placed as Graph-1 relationship legs.

hostile_resolved_target_missing_security.purpose: RESOLVED target identity_resolution carries a null security_id.

hostile_rights_blocked_claimed_supported.purpose: Only Graph-1 leg is rights_blocked but graph_states.graph_1 still claims supported.

hostile_role_laundering.purpose: A generic-agreement leg (disclosed_agreement_role_unknown) claims a specific economic role.

hostile_sha_mismatch.purpose: Field tampered WITHOUT recomputing content_sha256 (the stale-hash exception fixture).

hostile_unresolved_identity_laundered.purpose: NOT_IN_MASTER identity with abstained flipped false and evidence legs smuggled in.

hostile_unresolved_source_identity_suppo.purpose: source_event.source_identity is UNRESOLVED while the record claims a non-abstained supported_hypothesis.
